# An ADR whose frontmatter omits the `status` key writes successfully: the
# status rules guard on key presence, so an absent key makes them vacuously
# true. A present-but-invalid value still fails validation; the invalid-enum
# ADR case is covered in lint_tests.txt.

exec akb init adr-write-kb
cd adr-write-kb

stdin ../adr-missing-status.md
exec akb write bad-adr.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/bad-adr.md'

deciders: team

---
## Context

An ADR whose frontmatter omits the status field.

## Decision

Decision without status.

## Consequences

None.
